The following notes cover several ordinary problems. Mira has twelve red marbles and seven blue marbles. She gives four red marbles to Sam and buys three blue marbles. The sum is eighteen. A Python function can sum even integers by checking whether the remainder after division by two is zero. For the list one, two, three, and four, the result is six. Paris is the capital of France, and Berlin is the capital of Germany. A traveler leaves home at nine in the morning and arrives at noon after three hours on the train. In a garden, the tomatoes need water every other day while the trees need water once a week. The bridge over the river connects two small villages. A librarian sorts books by author and writes the date on each lending record. If a class has twenty students and five leave, fifteen remain. A square has four equal sides and four right angles. A triangle has three sides, and its angles add up to one hundred eighty degrees. The kitchen has apples, flour, eggs, and milk. To make a simple cake, mix the ingredients, pour them into a pan, and bake until the center is cooked. Remember to let the cake cool before slicing it. The engineer checks the measurements twice before cutting the wood. Clear instructions help everyone understand what needs to happen next. The final task is to explain these examples carefully and accurately. The river crossed the valley from north to south. A wooden bridge connected the two villages. Every morning the farmers carried apples and grain to the market. The librarian recorded the weather, the date, and the number of visitors. In the evening everyone returned home before the lamps went out.
